approved_command_preview: Revalidate the bounded DCOIR Review precision tranche after scoping the regression to known builtin execution false positives. Run Pareto/hardened, v16/v19, precision corpus metrics, module loader, local validation, Windows PowerShell compatibility, CodeQL workflow validation, and diff hygiene. Do not mutate reviewer source.
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$sourceCommit = '8135256904db8b76d71d48b41d5d8a7d15db275f'
& git merge-base --is-ancestor $sourceCommit HEAD
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Expected DCOIR source commit $sourceCommit is not an ancestor of workflow HEAD" }
& git diff --quiet $sourceCommit HEAD -- .github/dcoir_review
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'DCOIR Review source changed after the guarded source commit' }
$pythonTests = @(
  '.github/dcoir_review/scripts/openrouter_pr_review_pareto_context_selftest.py',
  '.github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_required_runtime_patch_v16_selftest.py',
  '.github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_required_runtime_patch_v19_selftest.py',
  '.github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_precision_regression_selftest.py',
  '.github/dcoir_review/scripts/openrouter_pr_review_hardened_selftest.py',
  '.github/dcoir_review/scripts/openrouter_pr_review_quality_recovery_selftest.py',
  '.github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_runtime_module_loader_selftest.py',
  '.github/dcoir_review/scripts/validate-codeql-security-workflow.py'
)
foreach ($test in $pythonTests) {
  Write-Host "RUN python $test"
  python $test
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Validation failed: python $test" }
}
Write-Host 'RUN validate-codex-local.sh'
bash .github/dcoir_review/scripts/validate-codex-local.sh
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'validate-codex-local.sh failed' }
Write-Host 'RUN Windows PowerShell compatibility validator'
pwsh -NoProfile -File .github/dcoir_review/scripts/validate-windows-powershell-51.ps1 -AllowPowerShell7 -AllowEmpty
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows PowerShell compatibility validation failed' }
Write-Host 'RUN git diff --check'
git diff --check
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git diff --check failed' }
Write-Host "Validated DCOIR Review source commit: $sourceCommit"
